title: The World’s Longest Man-Made River: 1,776 km, 2,500 Years Old | China Travel Expert
description:
The longest artificial waterway on Earth is still working after 2,500 years.

China’s Grand Canal runs about 1,776 km from Beijing to Hangzhou — the oldest and longest man-made waterway in the world. Its earliest section was dug around 486 BCE and the Sui dynasty joined it into one system from 605 CE. It became UNESCO World Heritage in 2014, and a working stretch still carries roughly 260 million tons of cargo a year. The best way to feel it is a slow ride through the canal towns strung along it.

🧭 Expert Tip: Skip the highway and take an evening boat through Suzhou’s canals — it is a living piece of the old Grand Canal route.

一条运河，1776公里，挖了两千五百年，至今还在跑船。
